# Langston Hughes — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Langston Hughes known for?", "Harlem Renaissance"),
    ("What field did Langston Hughes work in?", "poetry"),
    ("What is lived?", "1901-1967"),
    ("What is field?", "poetry"),
    ("What is known for?", "Harlem Renaissance"),
    ("What is note?", "Jazz poetry pioneer"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")

    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
